metadata.street_name: Avinguda de la Riera de Cassoles

scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with buildings on both sides, lined with trees and trashcans along the sidewalk. The street is paved with gray square tiles and has a few pedestrians walking along it. There are several storefronts on the right side of the street, including one called HANDSEI & CO. The building has a sign hanging from its facade, and there are several windows and doors along the front. The sky is bright and sunny.
